prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle ahead of them slowed abruptly and that they were unable to stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 remained in the driver's seat upon my arrival and reported pain in the left knee, stating it struck the dashboard during impact. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle reported no injuries. Both vehicles sustained visible rear and front-end damage and were drivable only after being moved to the shoulder. Skid marks were noted from Driver 2's vehicle approximately twelve feet before the point of impact. Driver 1 was evaluated on scene by responding EMS personnel and was transported for further medical assessment as a precaution. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Citations were issued to Driver 2 for following too closely.
